entities.name: Protected piperazine
observations: Input substrate is methylcarbamoylmethyl piperazine-1-carboxylate, CNC(=O)COC(=O)N1CCNCC1; it has one secondary piperazine N available for alkylation.

entities.name: Bromoethyl chlorophenyl ether
observations: Input electrophile is 1-(2-bromoethoxy)-4-chlorobenzene, BrCCOc1ccc(Cl)cc1; bromide is the leaving group.

entities.name: Piperazine N-alkylation product
observations: ORD-matched product is CNC(=O)COC(=O)N1CCN(CCOc2ccc(Cl)cc2)CC1, formed by replacing the electrophile's terminal bromide with the free piperazine nitrogen.

entities.name: Piperazine SN2 alkylation
observations: Secondary piperazine N substitutes for bromide on the 2-bromoethyl aryl ether; aryl chloride remains intact.
